name: Conversation
description: A container for displaying a list of chat messages with auto-scroll and loading states
designIntent: The Conversation component manages the display of multiple messages in a chat interface. It handles auto-scrolling to show new messages, distinct avatar configurations for users and assistants, and a loading state when the AI is generating a response.

props.name: messages
props.description: Array of message objects to display
examples: [{ id: '1', role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }, { id: '2', role: 'assistant', content: 'Hi!' }]

props.name: showAvatars
props.description: Whether to show avatars for messages

props.name: userAvatarSrc
props.description: Custom avatar image URL for user messages

props.name: assistantAvatarSrc
props.description: Custom avatar image URL for assistant messages

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Whether the assistant is currently generating a response

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the conversation container

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Custom renderer applied to every message (e.g. markdown).

props.name: streamingMessageId
props.description: ID of the message still generating; renders its streaming cursor and auto-scrolls.

examples.title: Basic conversation
examples.code:
<Conversation 
  messages={[
    { id: '1', role: 'user', content: 'Hello' },
    { id: '2', role: 'assistant', content: 'Hi there!' }
  ]}
/>
examples.description: Simple conversation with user and assistant messages

examples.description: Conversation with custom avatar images and fallbacks

examples.description: Conversation showing loading indicator while AI responds

antiPatterns.title: Don't manage state inside Conversation
antiPatterns.description: Conversation should be a controlled component. State should be managed by the parent.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use for non-chat content
antiPatterns.description: Conversation is specifically for chat messages, not general data display

accessibility.implementation: Consider adding aria-live to the container for screen readers to announce new messages
accessibility.userRequirements: For streaming responses, use aria-live='polite' to avoid interrupting users

accessibility.implementation: Container is scrollable with keyboard. Focus management depends on parent component
accessibility.userRequirements: Ensure users can navigate through messages with keyboard if needed

accessibility.implementation: Loading state is visually indicated but not announced to screen readers by default
accessibility.userRequirements: Consider adding aria-live region for loading state if needed

guidelines: Keep loading messages brief and informative
Avoid specific time estimates (which are often inaccurate)
Use consistent loading text across the application
Consider the context (what action is being performed)
Use consistent abbreviations for user and assistant
User fallback should be based on user's name or identity
Assistant fallback should clearly indicate it's an AI
Keep to 1-2 characters for best appearance

compositionRules.relationship: Conversation renders multiple Message components internally
compositionRules.example: Conversation maps over messages array and renders Message for each item

compositionRules.relationship: PromptInput is typically used alongside Conversation to submit new messages
compositionRules.example: Conversation displays messages, PromptInput adds new ones to the messages array
